REPORT_DIR = "reports"

import os

REPORT_DIR = "reports"

    return sum(item["qty"] for item in items)


def page(items, number, size):
    """Return one page of items; pages start at 0."""

    return items[start:start + size + 1]

    """Return the text of a report that the user picked by name."""

        return handle.read()


def sync_all(items, push):
    """Push every item and return how many were sent."""
    sent = 0
    for item in items:
        try:
            push(item)
            sent += 1
        except Exception:
            pass
    return sent
